title: RoboArena: Distributed Real-World Evaluation of Generalist Robot Policies
venue: Proceedings of The 9th Conference on Robot Learning, PMLR 305, 2025

source_findings.location: Section 3.1 and Algorithm 1, PDF physical page 4
source_findings.finding: The stated evaluation protocol has the central server sample two policies from the pool, describes that sampling as random, assigns the pair to an evaluator, and requires closely matched initial conditions within the A/B comparison.

The paper anticipates a long-running benchmark whose policy set evolves as weaker policies are dropped and stronger policies are added, and it evaluates simulated task-distribution and policy-set shift.
The described central server tracks newly registered or deprecated policies in the policy pool.
